0: (until [ -S /run/dind/docker.sock ]; do sleep 1; done; mkdir -p /tmp/ansible && mount --bind /var/ansible /tmp/ansible) & exec dockerd-entrypoint.sh --host=unix:///run/dind/docker.sock --storage-driver=overlay2
env: "prod" AND status:~"error|warn" | stats by (service, kubernetes.pod) count() as errorLog | filter errorLog:>0

* | extract "ip=<ip> " | extract "status_code=<code>;" | stats by (ip) count() if (code:~"4.*") as failed, count() as total | math failed / total as failed_percentage | filter failed_percentage :> 0.01 | fields ip,failed_percentage

[global]
server_name = "eno1.dev"
address = ["::"]
port = 8008

log = "info"

database_path = "/data"
database_backup_path = "/backups"
database_backups_to_keep = 1

rocksdb_compression_algo = "zstd"
rocksdb_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression = true

max_request_size = 20971520

query_over_tcp_only = true
ip_lookup_strategy = 3

allow_registration = true
registration_token_file = "/config/token"
new_user_displayname_suffix = ""

allow_federation = true

# Additional config
[global.well_known]
client = "https://m.eno1.dev"
server = "m.eno1.dev:443"
